+---

+- 01KXY0ZVCCPBKZ1ANETWZ8Y8QQ

+title: 'MiniMax-M3: vision tower + image input (VL completion)'
+---
+## What
+
+Complete the VL half deferred by the text-first scope: vision tower + processor image path, mirroring mlx-vlm's `mlx_vlm/models/minimax_m3_vl/vision.py` and `processing_minimax_m3_vl.py`. Structural template in this repo: `Libraries/MLXVLM/Models/Qwen3VL.swift` (vision tower + merger in one model file) and `Libraries/MLXVLM/MediaProcessing.swift` helpers.
+
+1. **Vision tower** in `Libraries/MLXVLM/Models/MiniMaxM3.swift`: 32-layer ViT, hidden 1280, 16 heads, patch 14, image size up to 2016, **3D RoPE** (theta 10,000), patch-merge token compression (spatial merge 2, temporal patch 2, max 4 video frames), projection to 6144 (`multi_modal_projector`).
+2. **Un-drop vision weights**: revise ^xgvth41's `sanitize` to keep and remap the vision-tower/projector keys.
+3. **Processor image path**: replace ^wz8y8qq's throwing stub — image preprocessing per the repo's `preprocessor_config.json` (grid pinpoints 336–2016, image token index 200,025, video token 200,026, image seq len 576), splicing image embeddings at token positions like the other VLM implementations in this repo.
+4. Video input may remain a throwing stub if the repo's other VLMs don't do video either — match the repo's prevailing capability level and document; if video is descoped, say so in the task's completion notes for user visibility.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] Tiny-config vision tower forward pass produces the expected `(tokens, projectionDim)` embedding shape; 3D RoPE unit-tested on a hand-built position grid
+- [ ] Full-weights load keeps vision keys with zero unconsumed keys
+- [ ] Gated integration test: MiniMax-M3-4bit answers a question about a real test image sensibly (pattern: existing VLM integration tests in `IntegrationTesting`)
+- [ ] Text-only generation (^wz8y8qq coherence test) unaffected
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] Extend `Tests/MLXLMTests/MiniMaxM3Tests.swift`: vision-tower shape + 3D RoPE tests, processor image-path unit test (synthetic image, no weights)
+- [ ] Gated integration image Q&A test
+- [ ] Run: `swift test --filter MLXLMTests` → green; integration image case passes
+
+## Workflow
+
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
